title: Bounded cohomology, quotient extensions, and hierarchical hyperbolicity: the pullback lemma for quotient extensions
author: Francesco Fournier-Facio, Giorgio Mangioni, Alessandro Sisto
work: Bounded cohomology, quotient extensions, and hierarchical hyperbolicity
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's pullback lemma for quotient extensions (source0.tex lines 335-338, source label 'qce pullback'): with the notation of the article's quotient-extension diagram, the pullback map on second bounded cohomology sends the class of the quotient extension to the class of the extension, so boundedness descends along the quotient. The retained complete proof (lines 340-368) is a genuine 29-line argument, not a routine verification: it chooses compatible normalised sections of the two central extensions, splits elements of the middle group along a section of the quotient map, verifies that the constructed section is normalised and compatible with the quotient section, and then identifies the resulting cocycle with the pullback of the cocycle of the quotient extension. The residual difficulty is the explicit cocycle-level computation on a commutative diagram of central extensions, with the compatibility of two chosen sections tracked by hand; this is research-level bounded cohomology well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying exercises.
